rows.headline: Stock Market Today, July 23: Tesla Stock Crashes on Earnings Miss and Rising AI Spending
rows.prelim_note: Tesla Q2 adjusted EPS $0.33 vs $0.50 est. (33% miss), adjusted EBITDA $3.2B vs $4B est.; stock fell 14.5% to an 11-month low; full-year capex confirmed above $25B — clears earnings/margin and analyst-expectations materiality criteria.

rows.headline: Alphabet Q2 2026 slides: 24% revenue growth, cloud surges despite capex
rows.prelim_note: Alphabet posted its first-ever negative free cash flow (-$5.9B) as Q2 capex hit $44.9B and FY26 capex guidance was raised to as high as $205B (from $180-190B) — clears cash-flow and capital-structure materiality criteria.

rows.headline: American Airlines Warns of Possible Loss as Fuel Prices Weigh on Outlook
rows.prelim_note: American Airlines cut FY26 adjusted EPS guidance to a range of -$0.65 to +$0.65 (from -$0.40 to +$1.10) on ~$2.2B added fuel costs this year tied to the Iran conflict; stock fell 9.2%, the most in a year — clears margin and analyst-expectations materiality criteria.

rows.headline: Albertsons Cuts Profit Forecast as Consumer Demand Weakens, Shares Drop
rows.prelim_note: Albertsons cut FY26 adjusted EPS guidance to $1.75-$1.85 (from $2.22-$2.32) and adjusted EBITDA to $3.55-$3.625B (from $3.85-$3.925B) on softer grocery demand and trade-down; shares fell 13.8-20% and the company is collapsing 11 operating divisions into 4 — clears revenue/margin and management-credibility materiality criteria.

rows.headline: Iberdrola Agrees to Buy 80% Stake in Caruna Group for €2 Billion
rows.prelim_note: Iberdrola agreed to buy an 80% stake in Finland's largest electricity distributor Caruna (valued at ~€5B including debt) for €2B ($2.3B), closing expected Q1 2027 subject to regulatory approval — clears capital-structure materiality criteria (M&A).

rows.headline: Caspian Pipeline Consortium Halts Loadings on Drone Strike
rows.prelim_note: Drone strikes on tankers loading at the CPC terminal (Novorossiysk) forced a halt to loadings and a cut to Kazakh crude production; CPC carries ~80% of Kazakhstan's oil exports — distinct from the Bab el-Mandeb/Black Sea shipping items already in today's inbox; clears supply/demand and operational-risk materiality criteria.

rows.headline: European Commission approves Paramount-Warner Bros. Discovery merger, faces US court challenge
rows.prelim_note: EU cleared the ~$111B Paramount-Warner Bros. Discovery merger with conditions (Paramount must end its Universal film-distribution partnership in Europe); a US federal judge has meanwhile temporarily halted the deal pending a 12-state injunction hearing — clears capital-structure and regulatory/legal-risk materiality criteria.
